title: Cancellation of Installation Jobs
content:
Contract terms on cancelling an **Installation Jobs** record.

## Terms

1. An installation job is cancelled only after its contract has been cancelled.
2. A job that is opened or scheduled is cancelled and any booked crew date is released without a reschedule fee.
3. A job whose work has started cannot be cancelled; once the crew is on site the job runs to completion.
4. Job charges already assessed before cancellation stay owed and are settled with the contract's cancellation.

The contract in term 1 is the window contract or door contract the job installs, and the test is that contract's status in the system record, not the customer's statement.

## Decision table

| Contract the job installs | Job status | Cancellation of the job |
|---|---|---|
| Cancelled | opened | Cancelled; no reschedule fee |
| Cancelled | scheduled | Cancelled; the booked crew date is released without a reschedule fee |
| Cancelled | in progress, completed or closed | Not cancelled; the job runs to completion |
| Not cancelled | any | Not cancelled |

## Points of judgement

- **Charges before cancellation.** A job charge assessed before the job was cancelled is not removed by the cancellation; it stays owed and is settled with the contract's cancellation.
- **Released crew date.** Releasing the crew date of a scheduled job on cancellation carries no reschedule fee.
